entities.name: Marhault Elsdragon
entities.description: Half-elven general of the kentsu under Emperor Nicol Bolas during Lady Caleria's uprising.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Dragon emperor of Madara, whom Marhault serves.

entities.name: Lady Caleria
entities.description: Leader of an uprising against the Empire of Madara.

entities.name: Empire of Madara
entities.description: The empire ruled by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: An agent who corrupts Jorgan Hage and later takes control of the kentsu.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: A champion placed under Elsdragon's leadership.

entities.name: Jorgan Hage
entities.description: A short-tempered Aerathi berserker and Marshal, corrupted by Ramses, who kills Elsdragon.

entities.name: Ayesha Tanaka
entities.description: Informed Elsdragon of the defenders' movements and claimed the Sylvan Library.

entities.name: Orca
entities.description: A being summoned during the siege who turned on Umezawa.

entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: The war between Madara and the Edemi Islands.

entities.name: Kusho
entities.description: An Edemi island conquered by the kentsu.

entities.name: Argenti
entities.description: An island where defenders arranged a collective defense.

events.summary: Ramses Overdark visits Elsdragon's camp to ensure he will not interfere; Marhault says he acts only on the Emperor's word.
events.quote: Marhault simply stated he would only act if the Emperor bade him to.

events.summary: Ramses lures Jorgan Hage into a trap and corrupts him with black magic.
events.quote: Ramses then lured Hage into a trap, ambushing him and corrupting him with black magic

events.summary: The Emperor marshals the kentsu and sets Elsdragon to kill the leaders of Kusho and Argenti.
events.quote: setting Elsdragon to the task of killing the leaders of Kusho and Argenti .

events.summary: The kentsu conquer Kusho after initial resistance.
events.quote: After meeting with some initial resistance, the kentsu conquered the island

events.summary: Elsdragon leads the kentsu to Caleria's island, battling through the woods of Magnus.
events.quote: Elsdragon then brought the kentsu to Caleria 's island

events.summary: The summoning of Orca ends the siege by defeating the Akron Legionnaire and destroying the portcullis.
events.quote: only the summoning of Orca allowed the siege to come to an end

events.summary: Orca turns on Umezawa; in the distraction Hage smashes Elsdragon's head with his hammer.
events.quote: Jorgan Hage seized the opportunity of distraction and smashed Elsdragon's head with his hammer.

events.summary: Ramses Overdark takes control of the kentsu after being spared by Bolas.
events.quote: Ramses Overdark then assumed control of the kentsu after being spared by Nicol Bolas.

relations.quote: He was loyal to Emperor Nicol Bolas in every way
Marhault Elsdragon was the half- elven general of the kentsu

relations.note: smashed his head with a hammer
relations.quote: smashed Elsdragon's head with his hammer.
